children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - September 23, 2026) - Wisr AI Systems Inc.

("Wisr AI" or the "Company"), an AI-powered cyber and third-party risk intelligence company, is pleased to announce that it has joined the Canadian Association of Defence and Security Industries ("CADSI"), the national industry voice for Canada's defence and security industries.

CADSI represents Canada's defence and security industry and provides members with access to policy insights, procurement intelligence, market engagement opportunities and platforms that connect Canadian companies with government, defence leaders, allied nations and key industry stakeholders. Through initiatives including CANSEC and Cyber & Digital Outlooks, CADSI plays a central role in supporting companies operating across defence, cybersecurity, aerospace, public safety and national security markets.

The membership supports Wisr AI's defence and public-sector business development strategy, providing access to procurement intelligence and opportunities to engage with government stakeholders, defence contractors and potential partners. The Company intends to use these resources to identify potential commercial pilots and partnerships and inform defence-focused product development.

Wisr AI is developing dual-use defence and security applications for its sovereign AI and agentic risk intelligence platform. These applications are intended to help defence, critical infrastructure and other regulated organizations identify and monitor cyber threats, third-party exposure and supply-chain vulnerabilities.

"Joining CADSI provides an additional channel to engage with potential customers and partners in Canada's defence and security sector," said Rob Goehring, CEO of Wisr AI. "Our focus is on understanding customer requirements and pursuing pilot opportunities that demonstrate how our technology can address cyber and supply-chain risks in these markets."
The Company intends to continue advancing its defence and security strategy through product development, commercial pilots and strategic partnerships.
About CADSI

The Canadian Association of Defence and Security Industries is the national voice of Canada's defence and security industries. CADSI supports Canadian companies through advocacy, industry engagement, business development tools, market intelligence and events that connect members with government, defence, security and allied market opportunities.

About Wisr AI Systems Inc.
Wisr AI Systems Inc.

is a Vancouver-based technology company building agentic AI platforms that predict, prioritize, and monitor cyber and third-party risk. Its solutions help enterprises ingest and interpret real-time global signals to manage complex vendor ecosystems and supply chains more intelligently. Wisr AI empowers organizations with dynamic risk visibility and actionable intelligence to support stronger cybersecurity governance and operational resilience.
